source_title: COMAR 31.13.01.10 Prima Facie Premium Rates for Credit Life Insurance (Library of Maryland Regulations)
plan: Single premium decreasing term, single life (total-of-payments method)
basis: per annum per $100 of initial amount of insured indebtedness
rate_table_note: Rates are in 31.13.01.10A(1) to (3). Joint coverage of a husband and wife is at most 1.80 times the single life premium (B); not published as a figure, so not recorded. Other policy types and rating methods need the Commissioner's approval and must be actuarially consistent (C). Chapter history: .10 has not been amended since the chapter revision effective March 1, 2001 (27:22 Md. R. 2062).
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie credit life rates in COMAR 31.13.01.10: $0.43 per annum per $100 single premium decreasing term, $0.66 per month per $1,000 outstanding balance, and $0.71 per annum per $100 single premium level term, single life. The regulation says they apply to all premiums charged on or after March 1, 2001.

plan: Single premium, 12 months, 7-day, benefits not retroactive (elimination period)
basis: single premium per $100 of initial amount of insured indebtedness
rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in 31.13.01.15A, by number of months insured (2 to 120) and 7-, 14- or 30-day period, benefits not retroactive or retroactive; other terms by straight-line interpolation. Joint coverage is at most 1.80 times single (F). The chapter history lists .15A and E as amended effective June 1, 2016 (43:5 Md. R. 387); the MIA's Bulletin 16-11 of April 6, 2016 (a scanned image, not saved) describes that amendment as a reduction of the monthly outstanding balance composite rates in .15E (record MD-CD-2016-06-01) and says credit health prima facie rates had not been revised since 2001.
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie single premium credit health rates in COMAR 31.13.01.15A, per $100 of initial amount of insured indebtedness, for 12 and 60 months and 7-, 14- and 30-day periods, retroactive or not. The regulation says its rates apply to all premiums charged on or after March 1, 2001. Section A was amended effective June 1, 2016; the amendment is described as changing the outstanding balance rates in section E only, which is not confirmed from an official text copy.

rate_table_note: Rates are the schedule in 31.13.01.15E for group credit health insurance issued on the outstanding balance; the composite rate applies to all outstanding balances each month irrespective of loan duration. The effective date is from the chapter's administrative history. The rates before June 1, 2016 were not found in a saved official text (gap).
summary: Maryland reduced its prima facie composite monthly outstanding balance rates for group credit health insurance (COMAR 31.13.01.15E) effective June 1, 2016, to $0.08 (14-day nonretroactive), $0.07 (30-day nonretroactive), $0.11 (14-day retroactive) and $0.09 (30-day retroactive). Old rates not recorded. Per Bulletin 16-11 (scanned, not saved) the amendment was proposed in the Maryland Register on December 28, 2015 and adopted March 4, 2016, after the Commissioner's 2014 loss ratio study.

source_title: COMAR 31.13.03.10 Prima Facie Premium Rates for Credit Involuntary Unemployment Insurance (Library of Maryland Regulations)
plan: Single premium, 12 months repayable, maximum 6 benefits per occurrence, benefits retroactive, 30-day waiting period
basis: per $10 of monthly benefit payable
rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium tables in 31.13.03.10A(1) (retroactive, 30-day waiting period) and A(2) (not retroactive, 30-day elimination period), by months repayable (9 to 120) and maximum number of benefits per occurrence (6, 9, 12, 18, 24; for 12 months only 6 and 9 are printed), and the monthly premium schedule in B. Family leave coverage may add up to 4 percent (C). Rates per $100 of outstanding balance per month must be consistent with these (E, formula M = R x 10 x P). The chapter took effect January 1, 2003 (29:12 Md. R. 934); .10 has not been amended since.
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie credit involuntary unemployment rates in COMAR 31.13.03.10, per $10 of monthly benefit: single premium tables by loan term and maximum benefits (for example $14.095 retroactive and $9.887 not retroactive for 60 months and 12 benefits) and monthly premium rates ($0.268 and $0.188 for 12 benefits). They apply to premiums charged on or after the chapter's effective date, January 1, 2003.
